FN-XFHJZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 320
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/17/2023
House Bill 320 as introduced would rename the "Local Government Pistol Permit Revenue
Loss Fund" to the "Sheriffs' Advancement in Education, Technology and Training Fund" and
appropriate $7.5 million from the State General Fund (SGF) in fiscal years 2024 through 2028
to that fund. This would increase the obligations of the SGF by: (1) up to $5.5 million for fiscal
years 2024 through 2026; and (2) $7.5 million for fiscal years 2027 and 2028. According to the
Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs, approximately $655,000 in grants
have been provided to the various counties from this fund, as of the first quarter of calendar year
2023.
This bill would also: 1) provide a 90-day grace period , beginning on the effective date of this
bill, for counties to submit delinquent required reports; 2) authorize use of grant funds for the
same purposes which pistol permit fees were authorized as of December 31, 2022, instead of
January 1, 2023 as provided by current law; 3) require grant funds to be deposited into the
separately established local fund within 30 days of receipt of funds; 4) provide that such grant
funds shall be allocated in the same manner as pistol permit revenues; 5) prohibit a county
commission from retaining grant funds beyond what is authorized by law; and 6) provide that
grant funds would be expended at the discretion of the sheriff.
Further, this bill would extend the automatic repeal date for these provisions from January 1,
2027, under current law, to January 1, 2029.
